planned_by: Claude (Critic): blueprint §23 Remote MCP, read-only first
goal:
T41 — a read-only MCP server so any MCP client (other agents included) can query EvoForge and verify its proofs.

Implement MCP's JSON-RPC 2.0 over a single HTTP endpoint, POST /v1/mcp (stateless; no new dependency):
- "initialize" -> {protocolVersion: echo the client's if it is "2025-06-18" or "2025-03-26", else "2025-06-18",
  capabilities: {tools: {listChanged: false}}, serverInfo: {name: "evoforge", version}}; "notifications/initialized"
  (no id) -> HTTP 202 with empty body.
- "tools/list" -> exactly these read-only tools, each with a description and a JSON Schema inputSchema (type object):
  get_performance {}, get_proof {evidence_id}, verify_certificate {certificate: object}, list_missions {},
  get_mission {mission_id}.
- "tools/call" -> {content: [{type: "text", text: <JSON string>}], isError: false}; reuse the existing handlers
  (performance(), _mint_proof / stored certificates, proof.verify, missions_store) so results equal the REST API.
  Unknown tool or bad arguments -> isError true with a short message (or JSON-RPC -32602).
- Errors: unknown method -32601, invalid JSON -32700, invalid request -32600, with "jsonrpc": "2.0" and the request id.
- No tool may write, start jobs, call the model or return code/diffs/sealed tests.
Also: apps/web/lib/proxyPolicy.ts + proxyPolicy.cases.json allow POST /v1/mcp; services/api/evoforge/mcp_server.py
holds the dispatch (main.py only mounts the route). Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t41.py.
